name: zelta-bmi-india
description: Calculates adult BMI from height and weight and shows the category under the Asian-Indian consensus cutoffs, where overweight starts at 23 and obesity at 25, next to the international WHO categories. Also gives the weight range that sits in the normal band for a given height. Screening numbers only, not a diagnosis.
